notes: Excluded under PROTOCOL §4 (duplicates) and the closed list (FT-DUPLICATE, first applicable). Primary record: P00133 (arXiv 2109.01861 v1, already coded; stratum speed; retest_candidate true). P00676's DOI 10.48550/arxiv.2109.01861 is the arXiv DOI of the same preprint, so the two pool records are one arXiv record: the arXiv API and abs page (2026-09-24) give the same title, the same two authors, submission on 4 Sep 2021 and a single version, v1. The screening sheet already flagged P00676 as a possible duplicate of P00133 and P00552 (audit/pool/possible_duplicates.csv: title similarity 1.00 with P00133, 0.73 with P00552). P00552 (Computer-Aided Design 2022, retitled) is the version of record of the same study. P00133 reports it as not open access (only an accepted-manuscript licence from 2023-05-10 in Crossref), so under the FT-DUPLICATE definition the latest arXiv version, i.e. the record P00133 codes, is the primary version. P00552 is not coded; if its version of record becomes readable, the verifier should decide whether it replaces P00133 as primary.
